aoi.basis: Chọn hộp ±0.015 độ quanh tâm hộp bao relation OSM 14929839 tên Phường Gia Lộc. Đây là vùng mẫu kỹ thuật do nhóm chọn, không phải ranh hành chính; tâm hộp bao không phải trụ sở hay trọng tâm dân cư.
aoi.label: Vùng mẫu quanh vị trí tham chiếu Gia Lộc từ OSM — không phải ranh phường
limitations: Chưa tải được ranh hành chính được cơ quan có thẩm quyền xác nhận.
Tọa độ cộng đồng OSM có sai số chưa xác định; không là điểm khống chế đo đạc.
Vùng mẫu có thể cắt qua khu vực lân cận; không tính tỷ lệ bao phủ toàn phường.

officialIdentity.basis: Điều 1 khoản 96 Nghị quyết 1682/NQ-UBTVQH15: xã Phước Đông (huyện Gò Dầu) và phường Gia Lộc thành phường Gia Lộc.
officialIdentity.name: Phường Gia Lộc, tỉnh Tây Ninh

missing_readiness_note: No record is ready unless it is acquired, has verified local bytes, a verified snapshot, and mapped requirements.

records.data_date: 2010-2018 source period per Copernicus WorldDEM attribution notice; public COG tile last modified 2022-05-09 in S3 HEAD response
records.evidence_span: Data is provided as Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs.
records.license: Free basis for the general public under Copernicus DEM licence terms
limitations: Acquired layer is a coarse public DSM/DEM context tile, not LiDAR, DTM, point cloud, engineering survey, or centimetre orthophoto.
AOI intersection was verified against OSM-derived pilot bbox only; official ward boundary remains null.
Vertical datum is not asserted because it was not independently read from local TIFF tags.
AOI sample statistics are in derived/global/copdem-glo30-aoi-inspection.json.
records.resolution: 1 arc-second / 3600 px per degree, approximately 30 m class
records.title: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Public COG tile N11 E106 intersecting Gia Loc pilot AOI

records.evidence_span: The ESA WorldCover products are delivered in 3x3 degree tiles as Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs (COGs) in EPSG:4326 projection (geographic latitude/longitude CRS). There are 2651 tiles.
records.license: Free of charge, without restriction of use
limitations: Candidate only; no WorldCover tile was downloaded into raw/global in this handoff.
Land-cover classes are 10 m thematic context and cannot replace local object extraction or legal land-use layers.
Published overall accuracy is product-level, not a Gia Loc field validation.
records.resolution: 10 m map product; SWIR composite 20 m
records.title: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 global 10 m land-cover COG tiles

records.evidence_span: The underlying data product, estimated from Sentinel-2 imagery, has 10 m ground sampling distance.
records.license: Free of charge, without restriction of use
limitations: Candidate only; no canopy raster was downloaded for the pilot AOI.
The product estimates canopy top height using Sentinel-2/GEDI fusion and is not a tree inventory or terrestrial LiDAR point cloud.
Uncertainty layer should be acquired with canopy height before operational use.
records.publisher: ETH Zurich / Global Canopy Height project
records.title: ETH Global Canopy Height 2020 10 m product

records.evidence_span: The Open Buildings 2.5D Temporal Dataset provides annual data on building presence, fractional counts, and heights from 2016-2023 at a 4m effective spatial resolution.
limitations: Candidate only; Earth Engine access/export was not run and no local bytes were acquired.
Snapshot states model confidence is uncalibrated and building height validation is limited by geography.
Dataset is model-derived from Sentinel-2, not a surveyed building footprint/height layer.
records.resolution: 4 m effective spatial resolution; rasters provided at 0.5 m
records.title: Open Buildings 2.5D Temporal V1 Earth Engine dataset

records.evidence_span: Currently all of the mapped datasets are available to download (i.e. occurrence, change, seasonality, recurrence, transitions and maximum extent).
limitations: Candidate only; no 10x10 degree water tile was downloaded in this handoff.
Water occurrence/history products are not a calibrated drainage or flood model.
Snapshot warns about residual co-registration offsets after Landsat Collection 2 transition.
records.title: Global Surface Water 1984-2024 download products

records.evidence_span: GEDI science data products include footprint and gridded data sets that describe the 3D features of the Earth.
limitations: Candidate only; no GEDI granule or AOI extract was downloaded.
GEDI is spaceborne lidar footprint/gridded science data, not dense city point cloud and not centimetre survey.
Lower level products are distributed via LP DAAC/Earthdata workflows that still need per-product acquisition and license/access capture.
records.resolution: Footprint and gridded lidar products; exact footprint/grid resolution depends on GEDI product level
records.title: GEDI ecosystem lidar footprint and gridded data products

records.evidence_span: API keys are required for this API.
limitations: Blocked for direct API acquisition in this batch because no OpenTopography API key was authorized or available.
The documented global DEM API is not evidence of local airborne LiDAR or point-cloud availability over Gia Loc.
Must not be represented as acquired or as proof that centimetre-grade elevation exists.
records.resolution: Catalog includes multiple DEM products such as SRTM GL1 30 m, ALOS World 3D 30 m, COP30 30 m and GEDI_L3 1000 m
records.title: OpenTopography Global Datasets API and raster/catalog services

records.data_date: Global L2A availability since 2018-12 per snapshot
records.evidence_span: L2A data are available from April 2017 over wider Europe region and globally since December 2018.
limitations: Candidate only; no cloud-screened scene was selected or downloaded for Gia Loc.
Public satellite imagery is not centimetre orthophoto and is not a substitute for Hera payload capture.

R10 is only a candidate capability: construction/change comparison would require at least two comparable scene dates, cloud screening, co-registration/registration, band selection, CRS, tile asset hashes and explicit change logic.
records.resolution: Sentinel-2 MSI bands commonly 10 m, 20 m, 60 m depending band; not asserted for a selected scene here
records.title: Sentinel-2 L2A Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF archive

records.evidence_span: Bản đồ địa giới hành chính
limitations: Snapshot is an HTML article/page lead, not a machine-readable official boundary dataset.
Official boundary remains null until authoritative geometry is acquired.

limitations: Verified zero returned OSM building elements for this query and timestamp only.
This is evidence of an OSM data/query gap, not evidence that buildings do not exist on the ground.
records.title: OSM building ways query for Gia Lộc pilot AOI - zero returned elements

limitations: 629 OSM highway ways returned by query; no completeness guarantee for all roads.
Overpass returned full intersecting ways, so geometry bounds extend beyond the pilot AOI and are not clipped.
OSM positional accuracy and update completeness are unknown.
records.title: OSM highway ways intersecting Gia Lộc pilot AOI

limitations: Community OSM relation is not an official legal ward boundary.
Used only to derive a pilot AOI around the relation center; AOI is not full ward coverage.
records.title: OSM relation 14929839 Phường Gia Lộc metadata reference

limitations: 630 OSM ways returned by the combined query: 629 tagged highway and 1 tagged waterway.
Overpass returned full intersecting ways, so geometry bounds extend beyond the pilot AOI and are not clipped.
This record intentionally overlaps the separate highway and water receipts as the Contractor-verified combined snapshot for Batch 01.
records.title: OSM combined highway/water query intersecting Gia Lộc pilot AOI

limitations: 1 OSM waterway way returned; no natural=water way returned.
Overpass returned full intersecting way, so geometry bounds extend beyond the pilot AOI and are not clipped.
Hydrology completeness, classification and positional accuracy are unknown.
records.title: OSM waterway/natural water ways intersecting Gia Lộc pilot AOI

limitations: Multiple relevant CKAN catalog results have isopen=false and null license fields.
Do not treat these catalog hits as acquired or cleared-for-reuse datasets without rights review and resource download.
The CKAN catalog result does not provide a verified spatial extent for Gia Lộc; the bbox here is only the existing pilot AOI indexing envelope.
